title: The Dream
description:
After the destruction of the world caused by ww3 and Ai, The Galactic Federations declares  earth a radioactive wasteland and open to PvP. 

Synthians are a race dedicated to build and regrow life in destroyed planets, your mission is to clean the city and survive, basically a really hard waste collection Job, the more you clean the more money you make. This is the first game that i make so thats why its free :) . Runs on the steamdeck

Leaderboard: 

Discord: 

Lets clean and chill :D

Pulse gun upgrades: discover the secret upgrades and new firing modes for your gun .

Energy chargers: Replenish the energy of your gun.

Activate the cleaners to clean the air of the city and stop the enemy aliens.

The leaderboard: you can check the leaderboard at  or in the royal plaza inside the game!
description_short: The Dream is a minimal extraction adventure game, enter a dystopian vision in a post world war 3 set in Barcelona 2033. Survive, explore and clean the radioactive AI slop in Barcelona . Warning there is AI dropping slop everywhere, join the heroes of the plaza and save the city
